name: Beire (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Beire (a chalice and a sun on blue, timbred with a helmet and mantling).
history: Municipal flag of Beire; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
